can_prove_5_items.claim: Current auto LP probe should not start
can_prove_5_items.evidence: 5/5 Solana AMM protocols verify positive_realistic=0; canary/live/paper/dry-run (auto) should not start

can_prove_5_items.claim: Current 10/20U small capital probe has no sufficient EV support
can_prove_5_items.evidence: 5 stages cumulative 28560 EV cells; 10 USD at 25bps × 0.5%/day × 7d = $0.00875 gross; minus cost $0.006 = $0.00275; minus IL 0.5% × 7d × $10 = $0.35; net = -$0.35 at 7d realistic

can_prove_5_items.claim: Current model has 0 positive in optimistic/realistic/conservative for 5 Solana AMM
can_prove_5_items.evidence: 5 protocols × 28560 cells: 0 in realistic, 0 in optimistic, 0 in conservative; only 1898 in zero_il_lvr

can_prove_5_items.claim: Current connector work can be preserved
can_prove_5_items.evidence: 12 reusable modules (EVM V3, BSC, Base, 4 Solana AMM, EV framework, etc.); 5 connectors 100% SDK decode on mainnet

can_prove_5_items.claim: Current should pause auto protocol expansion
can_prove_5_items.evidence: 5/5 AMM already covered; marginal info value low; 7 reopen conditions required for any expansion

cannot_prove_6_items.claim_disproved: All LP long-term has no value
cannot_prove_6_items.why_cannot_prove: Study only covers retail 10/20U 2000 USD. Large capital ($1M+) + professional market making + hedging may still have positive EV. New protocols may change. EVM (Base, Arbitrum) V3 not tested.
5/5 reject is retail model, not institutional. Institutional LP has MEV income, bribe, incentive farming, hedging tools, lower cost basis. Different market.

cannot_prove_6_items.claim_disproved: Incentive LP / reward farming has no value
cannot_prove_6_items.why_cannot_prove: 5 stages only use pool.fee_rate. Protocol LM (liquidity mining) + bribes + IFO rewards not included. Some protocol LM is 5-10x fee. Need separate 7-reopen-condition verification.

cannot_prove_6_items.claim_disproved: Hedge / vault / JIT / active management has no value
cannot_prove_6_items.why_cannot_prove: 5 stages all vanilla LP (hold → fee → IL). Professional LP uses structural strategies with different EV model. Need separate verification.

cannot_prove_6_items.claim_disproved: Long-horizon or different market regime still negative
cannot_prove_6_items.why_cannot_prove: 5 stages heuristic 0.5%/day turnover (short window proxy). Long-horizon (90d/365d) backtest missing. Different market regime (uptrend/downtrend/sideways) varies. Need regime split.

cannot_prove_6_items.claim_disproved: Real fee accrual must be lower than proxy
cannot_prove_6_items.why_cannot_prove: 5 stages heuristic fee model only. Real LP position tokenId + actual fee claim history missing. Paid RPC/indexer missing. Real vs proxy bias not quantified. Need actual position-level data.

exact_conclusion_wording: Under current short-window data (heuristic 0.5%/day turnover, 4 IL/LVR scenarios), current model assumptions (heuristic fee/cost/IL proxies, no actual position data), no real LP tokenId/actual fee accrual, 5 Solana AMM protocols all negative EV for retail 10/20U 2000 USD LP.
not_what_we_say: All LP long-term has no value
Incentive LP / reward farming has no value
Hedge / vault / JIT / active management has no value
Long-horizon or different regime still negative
Real fee accrual must be lower than proxy
important_caveat: This audit does NOT change the 5/5 reject conclusion. Final recommendation remains STOP_LP_RESEARCH_NOW (main LP research line). But it PRECISES: (1) STOP scope = auto probe only, not all LP forever; (2) 7 reopen conditions NOW include longer horizon + actual fee + regime split; (3) reopen LP research must first satisfy these, then go through complete read-only → preflight → dry-run → manual approval.
